english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something being downright, complete, or utter.
Use this for an utter or out-and-out description, especially in expressions such as “unadulterated truth.”

examples.traditional: 呢次係不折不扣嘅失敗。
examples.jyutping: ni1 ci3 hai6 bat1 zit3 bat1 kau3 ge3 sat1 baai6

examples.english: What I'm saying is the unadulterated truth.
examples.traditional: 我講嘅係不折不扣嘅真相。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 ge3 hai6 bat1 zit3 bat1 kau3 ge3 zan1 soeng3
